- `nava-opcert-prod`, sha256 blob prefix 61689bf468f5, `added_at_log_position` 1784078198455948001-… (2026-07-14 PDT), `revoked_at_log_position: null`.
- `nava-opcert-prod rotated-20260907`, prefix 6e2a8414bf53, added 1788820816306746425-… (2026-09-07 PDT), added by 665d1d04801.

The first key was rotated out on 2026-09-07 but is still unrevoked, so it is still trusted for every position after that date. On the tickets history, the last authorship signature it made is at 1788820609355938280 (2026-09-07 15:36:49 PDT), just before the rotated key was added. The last op-cert signature it made has not been checked.

Before choosing, confirm that no op-cert or authorship signature by 61689bf468f5 is stored after that position.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] If revoking: the change lands through Gerrit, and enforced `verify-identity --all` plus the op-cert verification of existing certificates still pass on origin/tickets.
